blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has accepted the resignation of Maritime Industry Authority (Marina) Administrator Sonia Malaluan, Palace Press Officer Claire Castro said Monday. Castro confirmed this at a briefing, noting that a successor has already been identified but that she could not disclose the person’s name yet.
